author: NotThatSpecialToo
body:
I play as a mage and it is fun. I like the glass cannon concept but realize that melee is favored HEAVILY in Orna.   


1) The mage path is not glass cannon all the way. You have to go through ArchDruid to get to the "pure mage" classes like Nekro. AD is the worst class in the game by far (dodge mage with worthless Mag/DMG instead of glass cannon).   


I would recommend going melee (rogue style like Arcanic/Nyx) just to avoid the worst class in the game Archdruid. It is a horrible 25 levels of SLOG with weak DMG and slow grinding.    


2)Once you hit T9 the melee classes are superior to the only mage class available Omnimancer. Omnimancer is okay and actually fun to play but relies on RNG and is weak compared to other classes with Mystic Feather and other OP perks.   


3)Mage skills are weaker than the corresponding melee skills (Drain Vs Osmostrike for EX, Osmo is better)   


4) When you get to T9/T10 Ward becomes SUPER important and combined with Mystic Feather (low life but HIGH ward) PvP is shifted heavily in favor of Melle with Mystic Feather and high ward.   


5) Deific Channel is a super-powered version of Great meditation (melee>Mage)  


6) Even the mage specific perks like dual-wielding staves is literally worthless.   


In the end Melee classes with Mystic Feather out damage and out-survive mages in Gauntlet (mages need mana), World (dodge more as you can stay at low life for MF and maintain high ward), world-bosses (low life/High ward), and PvP.   


The pets are also better for mellee as you can get pets that offer berserk and other bonus stacks that mages cannot.   


Res DOuble down is rarer at higher tiers than DEF double down as well  


Mages are fun but if you entirely focused on max/min or what is overall better then you should go with the melee/Mystic Feather classes.

author: TheMauiWaui
body: For context, I'm at tier 6 following the warrior path but considering switching to mage. I've read the progression guides and watched many videos, but I'd like to hear more opinions from players of each class. All input is appreciated!

author: SilasVale
body: By the tone of your second paragraph, it seems like there's a few things you should know. First, all classes, including mage, need ward in the endgame, specifically for fighting Morri. There really isn't much of a way around that. Also, melee has Deific Channel, which is effectively a better Great Meditation. Also, pretty much every class has to potion constantly lmao. Typically, people will say that melee outdamages mage in the endgame, but it isn't by a large enough margin to say you need to pick one over another. Try out all the playstyles and see what you prefer.

author: rshawco
body: As you are in T10 you'll end up buying out all the classes anyways, as you get various gear you might change path based on some awesome gear drop. Play the game as its tons of fun, the path to 250 is pretty long you'll have a lot of time to play around with different styles.
